Package sharetea_pos

Class addOnController

java.lang.Object
sharetea_pos.addOnController
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.fxml.Initializable
public class addOnController extends Object implements javafx.fxml.Initializable
Controller for the add-on/topping selection popup. Allows customers to choose toppings, size, ice level, and sugar level for a drink order.
